This page is incomplete but should provide enough examples to get you started. The live links below are to the example installation at https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, but you can replicate them just by opening a local copy of iif-cite.html in a web browser. The examples use:

title: Addressable content
text:
Addressing raw IIIF manifest data

Start from the address of a ready-to-use installation of iiif-cite.html (e.g. https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, live link)
To add a IIIF manifest, append #manifest= (e.g., #manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json, live link)
To add a canvas id for a selected image, append &canvas= (e.g. &canvas=canvases/vol1_%2B_1r, live link)
To add a region of interest, append &roi= (e.g. &roi=0.3009,0.0101,0.2744,0.0586, live link). Multiple RoI values may provided, separated by semicolons. (e.g. &roi=0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940;0.1733,0.5565,0.5414,0.1967, live link)

title: Addressable content
text:
Addressing citable image data

Start from the address of a ready-to-use installation of iiif-cite.html (e.g. https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, live link)
Add a manifest with #manifest= and a URN map with urns= (e.g., manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&urns=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex, live link)
Append references to images with one or more additions of &urn= (e.g.urn=urn:cite2:citebne:complutensian1.v1:v1p5@0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940, live link)
